_comment: Fixtures for the leftover-marker detection tests. These live in a data file for the same reason scan-standards.mjs keeps its default list in default-markers.json: a test that exercises marker detection must contain marker strings, and any code file containing them literally is flagged by every marker-scanning tool in the repo — including the repo's own .git/hooks/pre-commit cleanup check, which blocked this commit until the fixtures moved here. Only code extensions are scanned, so JSON is inert.

namedOnly.why: array of marker names is a definition, not a leftover
config listing the marker as data

bothNamedAndLeft.line: const m = ['HACK']; // HACK actually left one
bothNamedAndLeft.why: naming it must not mask a real one on the same line

pluralProse.line: // ten FIXMEs in one file is one cleanup task, not ten issues
pluralProse.why: prose about the marker, plural form, must not match on word boundary

regexMetacharacters.why: unescaped regex build would throw and take the whole audit down
